paragraphs: 1. Payment. Fees are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.
Late fees accrue at 2% per month on any amount not paid when due.
2. Term. This agreement renews every year unless either party gives notice.

refusals.a second live lock on one item: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "uq_review_locks_item"
refusals.a lease past its bound: new row for relation "review_locks" violates check constraint "ck_review_locks_lease_bounded"
refusals.a lease that ends before its heartbeat: new row for relation "review_locks" violates check constraint "ck_review_locks_lease_order"
refusals.an unknown review kind: new row for relation "review_locks" violates check constraint "ck_review_locks_kind_known"
refusals.a negative version: new row for relation "review_item_versions" violates check constraint "ck_review_item_versions_nonnegative"
refusals.an ITEM anchor carrying a page: new row for relation "review_threads" violates check constraint "ck_review_threads_anchor_shape"
refusals.a PARAGRAPH anchor without its digest: new row for relation "review_threads" violates check constraint "ck_review_threads_anchor_shape"
refusals.a PARAGRAPH anchor without a document: new row for relation "review_threads" violates check constraint "ck_review_threads_anchor_shape"
refusals.a FIELD anchor without its field: new row for relation "review_threads" violates check constraint "ck_review_threads_anchor_shape"
refusals.a thread on another workspace's document: insert or update on table "review_threads" violates foreign key constraint "fk_review_threads_work_item"
refusals.a deleted comment keeping its text: new row for relation "review_comments" violates check constraint "ck_review_comments_body"
refusals.a live comment without text: new row for relation "review_comments" violates check constraint "ck_review_comments_body"

refusals.a comment in another workspace than its: insert or update on table "review_comments" violates foreign key constraint "fk_review_comments_thread"
refusals.the same client nonce twice: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "uq_review_comments_nonce"

rest.step: D4 HTTP 402 CAPABILITY_REQUIRED on all 10 live-review routes without the plan (valid bodies; each denial audited); optimistic concurrency on every plan

D5 threads: ITEM / FIELD / PARAGRAPH anchors (a stale digest is 409 ANCHOR_MOVED), idempotent submissions, mentions (an outsider refused; a notification without the text), author-only edits, audited moderation, resolve / reopen, open counts in the queue, anchors re-found after reprocessing (MOVED / OUTDATED), events carry ids only

D6 versions and locks: a stale version is 409 STALE_VERSION (nothing changed, nothing announced); a live lock refuses others in the hub AND on the source screen (409 LOCKED, holder named); the holder's decision clears it (announced after commit); 409 ALREADY_RESOLVED; an admin's audited lock break; bulk refuses per item and commits the rest
D8 ARCH-20 erasure: the subject's words leave every thread (the row keeps its place), discussions on their documents go, their locks are released; everyone else's comments stay

refused: a token in the query string
an organization whose plan lacks the capability (402 on REST)
a token issued before 'sign out everywhere'

results.gate: T1 capability in six places: entitlements (+Entitlement), 402 name, Enterprise only (not Business, not Developer), console constant + plan card label + order, hardening matrix; no locked nav page (the hub is core)

T2 migration: 4 tables, one live lock per item, the lease bound, anchor shape, composite FKs, idempotent comments, arch47 -> arch48 -> contract, one head, hub view and outbox vocabulary untouched, vocabulary parity
V1 protocol parity with the console: subprotocol, token prefix, live path, event and message types, close codes, anchor kinds, limits
A1 paragraph anchors: running headers and folios dropped, field lines kept, gaps split, layout-insensitive digests, CURRENT / MOVED / OUTDATED, quotes cut on a word
E1 publish after commit: a root rollback, a SAVEPOINT rollback (and what it contained), a close without commit publish nothing; nothing leaves before the commit; a broken broker never fails the write
B1 broker and hub: presence expires after PRESENCE_TTL, the queue digest reports changes only, dispatch crosses threads and event loops, nothing overtakes the hello
G1 handshake rules: the token in the subprotocol (or Authorization), never the query string; API keys refused; cross-origin and opaque origins refused; unknown hosts refused

W1 wiring: resolve_item takes the item's turn before every kind's service (9 kinds kept), 8 source decision routes guarded, bulk per-item savepoints in one lock order, erasure, router, models, Caddy route + token redaction on both sites, no new trigger, no XML

W2 API: 10 REST routes, each gated FIRST (402), CONTRIBUTOR (lock break ADMIN); the WebSocket authenticates host, origin, token, session, access, role and plan BEFORE it is accepted; open connections re-checked

W3 console: type parity (16 models), versions sent on resolve and bulk, the three 409 codes handled, live channel + avatars + lock badges + thread panel, token never in a URL, heartbeat, backoff, no raw Date formatting
S1 every ARCH-48 file carries its sentinel
S2 earlier verifiers widened with ARCH48-S1 sentinels, never replacing theirs
A2 apply_arch48.py --check on this tree: every file is the ARCH-48 result (a second apply writes nothing)
L1 real Caddy validates the Caddyfile (the live route and the header filter included)
D1 database at arch48: 4 tables, the hub view ARCH-47's, the capability on the published Enterprise tier only
D2 zero column drift between the ORM and the migration on the 4 tables

D3 schema refusals: one live lock per item, the lease bound and order, known kinds, NULL-safe anchor shapes, composite FKs (another workspace's document or thread), a deleted comment has no text, 20 mentions, one nonce; a document's deletion takes its discussions
D4 HTTP 402 CAPABILITY_REQUIRED on all 10 live-review routes without the plan (valid bodies; each denial audited); optimistic concurrency on every plan

D5 threads: ITEM / FIELD / PARAGRAPH anchors (a stale digest is 409 ANCHOR_MOVED), idempotent submissions, mentions (an outsider refused; a notification without the text), author-only edits, audited moderation, resolve / reopen, open counts in the queue, anchors re-found after reprocessing (MOVED / OUTDATED), events carry ids only

D6 versions and locks: a stale version is 409 STALE_VERSION (nothing changed, nothing announced); a live lock refuses others in the hub AND on the source screen (409 LOCKED, holder named); the holder's decision clears it (announced after commit); 409 ALREADY_RESOLVED; an admin's audited lock break; bulk refuses per item and commits the rest
D8 ARCH-20 erasure: the subject's words leave every thread (the row keeps its place), discussions on their documents go, their locks are released; everyone else's comments stay

D7 the WebSocket end to end (the full application, real tokens, sessions and tiers): 11 handshakes refused BEFORE accept (no / bad / query-string / API-key / expired token, viewer, outsider, no capability, cross-origin, unknown host, signed out everywhere); the subprotocol selected (never the token); hello first; presence; lock / LOCKED / heartbeat extends / unlock; two clients race for one lock (one wins); a resolution committed elsewhere reaches every console with its lock; a clean close releases, an abnormal one keeps; 1009, 4429, 4401 (token expiry, session revoked), 4403 (plan downgraded)

X1 two-client races on N sessions behind a barrier (committed): 16 who read it OPEN -> 1 decision + 15 ALREADY_RESOLVED; 16 at version 0 -> 1 + 15 STALE_VERSION; 12 lockers -> 1 holder; 2 bulk requests in opposite orders -> no deadlock, each item once; hub vs source screen -> 1

X2 lock expiry on a pinned clock: the heartbeat extends; a live lease is not taken; a lapsed one is free; the old token never revives it (nor a late heartbeat); the leader takes the badge down (EXPIRED) and notices queue changes; the database bounds every lease

X3 fan-out across TWO uvicorn worker processes through Redis: presence, locks, threads and a third process's resolution reach the console on the other process; refused handshakes are HTTP 403 on the wire; Redis carries ids, never comment text
C1 the REAL Caddy passes the WebSocket through (101, the subprotocol, frames both ways; a refusal is 403) and its access log keeps neither the token nor Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
